🚤 Honest numbers: small boat crossings are DOWN 43% on this point last year (21,198 vs 36,954, Home Office figures via ITV).

That's progress, and I'll say so. But it still means over twenty-one thousand people in under ten months — and the Home Office itself admits it "must go further".

The goal isn't fewer boats. It's no boats. 👇
